Method: min capacity 3250 mAh x nominal 3.6 V = 11.7 Wh = 42120 J (our product of two printed values; typ. 3350 mAh would give 43416 J; cross-check 243 Wh/kg x 48.5 g = 11.79 Wh). Capacity is at 25 C (footnote 2); the discharge rate of that footnote is not legible in our copy, and energy falls at higher rates and lower temperatures (datasheet discharge curves).
